text:
incident-bot: PAGE fired: cuda-mem-pressure detected on pool infer-us-west2-a (threshold: 92% gpu mem) -> PD:PD-TGT-23 :rotating_light:
serena-oncall: acked, I'm on it. pulling traces and node list.
alex-sre: thanks — can you check nvml errors on the pod logs? I saw a couple of `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` spikes in the metric spikes.
mohit-eng-runtime: copying recent nvml dump: `kubectl -n inference logs pod/infer-rt-7f4 --container=runtime | grep -i nvml -A3`
jess-customer-success: heads-up, two customers reported increased 429s ~1m ago, tagging in case they correlate: @acme-inc, @quickchat-app
serena-oncall: confirmed cluster-level mem pressure + repeated `CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED` in pod infer-rt-7f4. Evacuating that node now.
incident-bot: autopager action: scaled down pool infer-us-west2-a by 1 replica and triggered fallback routing to cpu-infer for new requests.
alex-sre: running node drain: `kubectl drain ip-172-31-22-9 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — evicting running pods, watch for stuck pods (OOM kill).
mohit-eng-runtime: observed KV cache thrash on that pool before OOMs, possible fragmentation. Increasing kvcache eviction aggressiveness temporarily: `PATCH /v1/runtime/config {"kvcache.eviction": "high"}`
serena-oncall: cluster autoscaler didn't spin up a replacement quickly due to AZ quota. Eng infra notified. @alex-sre can you enable soft-fallback for low-priority customers?
alex-sre: enabled soft-fallback routing; added header X-RW-Fallback: cpu for customers without strict SLOs. Rolling for the next 30s.
jess-customer-success: messaging sent to affected customers (status page draft) — tagging legal for any escalations.
serena-oncall: collecting heap traces, attaching truncated nvml excerpt:
```
NVML: GPU 0: Fan: 35% Temp: 72C MemUsed: 32768MB MemTotal: 32768MB
E 2024-05-08T14:22:10Z cuda: CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED at runtime.cpp:412
E 2024-05-08T14:22:11Z nvml: out_of_memory, pid=4123, pid_usr=serving
```
serena-oncall: looks like full allocation saturation on that card, likely fragmentation + large batch.
mohit-eng-runtime: can we throttle concurrent batch size on that pool? I can push a runtime policy: `max_concurrent_batches=2` for this pool.
alex-sre: pushed policy change, decreasing allowed concurrency, new requests should queue or route.
pagerduty-bot: escalation: no ack from secondary oncall within 3m -> paging backup oncall.
serena-oncall: noted. handoff plan: if we don't see stabilization in 10m, we'll evacuate the whole node group and rotate traffic away from us-west2-a.
jess-customer-success: confirmed 2 customers with high-impact: Acme Chat flow delay ~30s, QuickChat hitting 503 for a small subset. Ops message posted to status.redwood.ai/incidents/171660.
mohit-eng-runtime: added a temporary quantization override for the model serving large batches (reduce fp16 buffer usage) to try and lower peak mem usage.
alex-sre: eviction completed for most pods, one stuck pod with OOM loop — deleting it forcibly and letting replica set recreate. `kubectl delete pod infer-rt-7f4 --grace-period=0 --force`
serena-oncall: node drain completed. Memory pressure cleared from monitoring (GPU mem 45-60%).
jess-customer-success: (typo fixed) status update sent: "Mitigation in progress, some customers routed to CPU fallbacks; no data loss."
incident-bot: AUTO-RESOLVE check in 5m if metrics stable.
serena-oncall: leaving follow-up actions: 1) run kvcache defrag job on drained node image, 2) add burst limits to batcher, 3) check autoscaler quotas. Assigning to @mohit-eng-runtime and @alex-sre.
mohit-eng-runtime: will open a follow-up ticket with perf traces + suggested runtime patch.
alex-sre: I'll follow up on quota and create a runbook note for this memory fragmentation pattern.
serena-oncall: thanks team. marking thread for incident review. :white_check_mark:
